headline: Bank of Jamaica Holds $50 Million Foreign Exchange Intervention Sale
summary: Bank of Jamaica opened applications for a USD 50 million B-FXITT standard intervention tool sale operation on November 20, 2026, with settlement scheduled for November 23.
why: Bank of Jamaica is Jamaica's central bank, using periodic FX intervention auctions to manage foreign exchange market liquidity and price discovery.

impacts.name: Jamaican dollar
impacts.why: Central bank foreign exchange operations directly affect domestic currency market liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
